title: tragopogon flexuosus subsp. lithuanicus
intro: Tragopogon flexuosus subsp. lithuanicus, commonly known as Lithuanian salsify or Tragopogon, is a plant species within the genus Tragopogon and family Compositae. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and acting as an antioxidant, thereby aiding in the prevention of chronic diseases. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to stimulate digestive enzymes, promote wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Tragopogon flexuosus subsp. lithuanicus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
